sources.snippet: Whisper tiny Model Overview Whisper is a pre-trained model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. Whisper models demonstrate a strong ability to generalise to many datasets and domains without the need for fine-tuning. The models were trained on either English-only data or multilingual data.
